requirements.requirement: Current baseline, C211 held and executed source identities, C214/C215 authority/profile and accepted source input triple are pinned; prior source and failed evidence remain unchanged.
requirements.finding: Source/held/profile/history scope pinned; no prior source mutation.

requirements.requirement: Exact installed Blender executable and all installed importer-source bytes are hashed before native execution and checked again at native starts; Unknown upstream build lineage is reported without claiming source reproducibility.
requirements.finding: Executable/importer byte identities verified; initial loaded importer module predicate refused io_scene_gltf2.blender.com before runtime module receipt.

requirements.requirement: Exact capture implementation and all imported local helper bytes are bound to a committed source identity; the reviewer sees the complete native and launch code before launch.
requirements.finding: Exact committed source and prepared bytes independently reviewed.

requirements.requirement: A separate C216 experimental contract explicitly adopts exact retained source authority plus measured native shading/disclosed loss. It grants no native normal fidelity, replacement tolerance, production integration or retroactive C211 pass.
requirements.finding: Separate source-authority/disclosed-loss contract reviewed; no new normal tolerance.

requirements.requirement: A finite plan defines at most two native starts: one import/save/capture/render and one reopen/capture/render. It declares exact commands, time/resource bounds, expected files, comparison gates and stop rules; no exploratory start or version probe.
requirements.finding: Finite two-start plan reviewed; only first start attempted.

requirements.requirement: Every attempted start is durably recorded before launch; timeout/unknown outcomes are counted and reconciled before any retry. No automatic retry or unplanned rerender is permitted.
requirements.finding: One attempt reserved before process creation; known failure/exit19/group absent; no retry or reopen.

requirements.requirement: The plan distinguishes immutable prelaunch source/build/importer/settings locks from the post-save scene hash. A future scene hash cannot be represented as preknown. Final per-phase C215 observation locks are independently checked against the prelaunch bindings and actual saved scene.
requirements.finding: Staged scene binding reviewed; actual scene save and final lock were never reached.

requirements.requirement: The source is a separately identified future-proposed receiver, not relabeled held C211 correction. Denoising is explicitly disabled in actual Cycles scene and view-layer settings if Cycles is selected; the executed settings receipt verifies the correction.
requirements.finding: New source disables denoising but configuration did not execute; old held correction remains unexecuted.

requirements.requirement: Captured positions and corner normals come from actual native object-local mesh/loop data. Source normals never select correspondence or overwrite imported normals; unrelated geometry fixes, coordinate rounding, welding and topology alterations are absent.
requirements.finding: Native corner-reading source reviewed; no geometry/normal capture reached.

requirements.requirement: Captured native object, mesh, triangle and loop identities are explicit. Source instance binding uses retained metadata and validated source IDs rather than relying on incidental native ordering.
requirements.finding: Instance/native-identity capture source reviewed; native product mapping unrun.

requirements.requirement: All expected 18 source instances, 7800 triangle instances and 23400 corners enter the denominator. Missing, ambiguous, invalid, unmatched and reversed-winding records remain visible rather than being dropped.
requirements.finding: No native object/triangle/corner observations; source expected denominator is not native evidence.

requirements.requirement: An independent raw GLB reader reconstructs accepted local float32 positions/normals and original topology without using adapter correspondence or source-normal builder as its oracle.
requirements.finding: Independent raw GLB source oracle reconstructs all accepted 3024 source corners and 23,400 expected instance corners without production imports.

requirements.requirement: Independent correspondence uses source identity plus exact positions and orientation-preserving cyclic winding only, with fixed Blender (X,Y,Z) to glTF (X,Z,-Y) mapping. Drift/ambiguity is a blocker, not a relaxed tolerance.
requirements.finding: Exact position/winding correspondence reviewer ready; no native comparisons executed.

requirements.requirement: Component and angular loss are independently recomputed for every mapped corner; reported maxima, complete state counts and native IDs agree with independently derived values.
requirements.finding: No new native normals or C215 loss report produced.

requirements.requirement: The original 2e-6 normal threshold is reported separately as historical comparison and remains failed if exceeded; no new shading-fidelity pass is inferred from small loss.
requirements.finding: C211 original strict 2e-6 failure remains; no C216 normal values exist.

requirements.requirement: Native imported object identity, PBR values, selected world poses/units/frames and supported source semantics are checked against authoritative accepted source. Metadata preservation is distinguished from executable physics.
requirements.finding: Native material, semantic, unit and 126-pose comparisons not reached.

requirements.requirement: The actual saved .blend exists, is nonempty and is hashed. Accepted source-normal payload bytes and source references survive as paired retained authority; any in-scene source metadata/text claims are verified from actual native observations.
requirements.finding: No received.blend or actual retained native authority texts produced.

requirements.requirement: The second start opens that exact saved scene and does not reimport the GLB. The saved-scene file hash is checked before and after; any changed byte input requires an explicit new reviewed binding.
requirements.finding: Reopen was neither approved nor launched.

requirements.requirement: Reopen preserves full object identities, geometry, captured split normals, semantics and declared material/pose state under explicitly declared comparison rules; any differences remain disclosed.
requirements.finding: No saved-scene persistence comparison possible.

requirements.requirement: Useful actual native renders are generated from the inspected imported/reopened scene with declared camera/light/render settings, including views exposing the object assembly and sphere shading. Source and render bytes are bound.
requirements.finding: No native overview or curved-detail render produced.

requirements.requirement: A human-facing visual inspection checks framing, missing/extra parts, material appearance and visible surface shading. A successful render exit or numeric small error alone is not shading review.
requirements.finding: No new native image available for visual inspection.

requirements.requirement: Per-phase output/log/run receipts, measured settings, environment/build identity and process termination evidence are preserved; a successful launch never stands in for complete expected artifacts.
requirements.finding: Exact approval/reservation/launched/process/failure/log evidence preserved; expected incomplete outputs explicitly absent.

requirements.requirement: Only the isolated C216 experiment and root-owned navigation/status are changed. No prior adapter contract, source/runtime/exporter, held receiver, frozen schedule, tolerances or historical evidence is rewritten.
requirements.finding: Six additive C216 experiment files; original source/receivers/adapters remain unchanged.

requirements.requirement: C215 reports retain their fixed false evidence/provenance/fidelity flags. Any separate C216 result states only the external measured proof actually reviewed and keeps exact-source authority distinct from native representation.
requirements.finding: No adapter report or false acceptance field changed; no receiving-fidelity claim.

requirements.requirement: All required independent findings are accounted for with PASS/FAIL/UNRUN/BLOCKED evidence. A failed finite gate stops further native steps and produces a restorable checkpoint; full runtime regression/native lossless or general receiving claims are absent.
requirements.finding: Known concrete failure stops schedule; no optional broader test, fix or retry in C216.

requirements.requirement: Workers preserve source and original attempts; final package retains history/hashes and exact source/evidence references. Root owns final archive/offline restore/save verification and stopping.
requirements.finding: Worker evidence/source frozen; root owns repository disposition, final package, offline restore and confirmed save.
